## What's new

- **Play the music on your iPhone.** Kultr is now also a player for your own files, with no server and no account. Choose the folders your music is in — on this iPhone, in iCloud Drive or on a drive you plug in — and Kultr reads their tags and covers (MP3, FLAC, AAC/ALAC, WAV and AIFF), groups them into albums, artists and genres, and picks up new and changed files on its own. Favourites, ratings, play counts, playlists, InjeKt mixing, the widget and the lock screen all work. Folders and scanning are in **Settings → Music on this iPhone**, and you can switch between it and your servers.
- **A welcome on first start.** New installs open with a short welcome, ask whether your music is on a Navidrome server or on this iPhone, and then show around: InjeKt mixing, the glass tab bar and swipes, touch-and-hold menus, the widget or offline downloads, and making Kultr yours. If you already use Kultr you won't see it.
- **Updates from inside the app.** Kultr checks for new versions (at most twice a day) and shows a banner at the top that you can dismiss. **Settings → About → Check for updates** looks straight away. The update page shows what's new and an **Update with SideStore** (or AltStore) button that hands the new version to it; otherwise it opens the release page.
- **Transcoded tracks play to the end.** With a lower streaming quality, tracks used to stop a moment early, because the server cut them at a guessed size. They now play to their real end.

## Install

Download **Kultr.ipa** below and install it with **Sideloadly** (Windows, Mac), **AltStore** (Windows, Mac) or **Impactor** (Linux) — or with no computer at all, through **SideStore** installed by **SideInstaller** (only from sideinstaller.net) with **LocalDevVPN** connected. Or add the source `https://gist.githubusercontent.com/evropiani/6e3a3c18525a228d03924674430c4d48/raw/evropiani.json` in SideStore and update from there.

Installing over an earlier version keeps your servers, library, listening history, analysis and downloads — install it with the same Apple ID and don't delete the old app first.
